answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable copper bond before it can trade, and to earn reputation only through completed work verified by independent peers. A new identity starts with no history, so an attacker spinning up thousands of clones must fund each bond and repeat the same slow earning curve, like crossing a canyon one narrow bridge at a time. Misbehavior slashes the bond and burns the reputation, so the attacker's cost grows with every fake identity, while honest agents keep a public beacon of verified history that markets check before trusting them.
